steps.label: Test-DbaLastBackup
steps.sub: a real restore + DBCC CHECKDB, not just a file check

steps.label: Invoke-DbaDbMaintenance
steps.sub: weekly index and statistics upkeep on BrennanERP

code:
Backup-DbaDatabase -SqlInstance SQLDBA01 `
  -Database BrennanERP -Type Full `
  -Path '\\SQLDBA01\Backups\Full' `
  -CompressBackup -Checksum -Verify

Test-DbaLastBackup -SqlInstance SQLDBA01 `
  -Database BrennanERP -Destination SQLDBA02 |
  Select-Object RestoreResult, DbccResult
caption: RestoreResult = Success and DbccResult = Success -- real evidence, not an assumption.

code:
New-DbaAgentJob -SqlInstance SQLDBA01 `
  -Job 'BrennanERP - Full Backup'

New-DbaAgentSchedule -SqlInstance SQLDBA01 `
  -Job 'BrennanERP - Full Backup' `
  -FrequencyType Daily -StartTime 020000
caption: Four SQL Server Agent jobs run this unattended, every single day.

subtitle: From a 52-second report to under half a second.
